description.en: Builds a tree-sitter code graph for the agent: codegraph answers where a symbol is declared, what calls it, what it calls, what a change reaches and how one symbol reaches another, and codegraph_index builds or refreshes the index. Bundles 18 language grammars and indexes in the background.
description.zh: 为 agent 构建 tree-sitter 代码图谱：codegraph 回答符号在哪声明、被谁调用、调用谁、一次改动影响哪里、两个符号之间怎么连；codegraph_index 负责建索引与刷新。内置 18 种语言语法，索引在后台异步构建。
